cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned mine back like you. Office time. Our clock's taken us back to the meeting we missed; we can still attend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch was fast. This is too far back; I haven't received the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clocks corrected. Extra preparation time; let's get our notes ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's before the booking. The boss is asking me whether we need this meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Tell her no; we can keep that afternoon free.

reason: A copies a fast-watch correction as time-travel procedure, then covers the mistaken scale through successive benefits. Keep B's real booking consultation as the cause of cancellation, without a thematic recap.
